market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Thursday: Anthropic priced its IPO at US$83, above the range, and tech futures jump: QQQ 674.74 (+2.3%), SPY 739.68 (+1.3%), GOOGL +3.9%, AMZN +2.4%, AMD +3.7%, KLAC +4.3%, CRWV +6.2%, NVDA 154.53 (+2.4%). Yesterday NVDA's beat faded (-2.9%) and the dollar hit a 19-month high (DXY 103.7). VIX 22, 10-year 5.07%, WTI US$82.15, gold US$3,729, BTC US$63,922 with Fear & Greed 10. After yesterday's fade the desk wants the gap to hold past 10:30 before adding risk.
